online.title: Online payments
online.intro: Every payment guardians started through SSLCommerz, newest first. SSLCommerz is asked about each one by itself; you can ask again here.
online.reviewLink: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing to check} one {{count} payment to check} other {{count} payments to check}}
online.searchHint: Our transaction ID, the bank's transaction ID or a student ID
online.emptyHint: Guardians pay online from their fees page once the owner turns online payments on (Setup → Online payments).
online.receiptsHint: Paid online payments are in the day's closing under their own line.
online.checkQueued: SSLCommerz is being asked. The answer shows here in a moment.
online.checkTooSoon: It was asked less than a minute ago. Try again shortly.

review.title: Online payments to check
review.intro: SSLCommerz confirmed these, but something did not match, so nothing was posted. The owner or an admin applies the money to dues, records it as refunded outside the app, or dismisses what holds no money.
review.count: {n, plural, one {{count} to check} other {{count} to check}}
review.emptyHint: Online payments that need a person show here. Every other one became a receipt by itself.

reason.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The amount SSLCommerz confirmed differs from what we asked for
reason.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: SSLCommerz confirmed it in another currency than taka
reason.TRAN_ID_MISMATCH: SSLCommerz confirmed another payment than this one, or no bank transaction ID
reason.HIGH_RISK: SSLCommerz marked this payment as risky: verify the payer before applying
reason.DUES_CHANGED: These dues were paid another way, or changed, while this payment was in progress
reason.LATE_SUCCESS: The payment went through after it had been closed
reason.DUPLICATE: Money for this payment arrived twice
reason.UNMATCHED: Money paid to the institute's SSLCommerz store that no payment of ours asked for
reason.VOIDED: Its receipt was voided: apply the money again or record it as refunded

signal.UNMATCHED: Money no payment of ours asked for

review.amountUnknown: an amount it did not report clearly
review.neverApplied: This money is never applied to dues: give it back (SSLCommerz's merchant panel, or by hand) and record that here.
review.dismissNeedsCheck: Dismiss needs a check with SSLCommerz in the last 15 minutes that found no payment.
review.viewOnly: The owner or an admin decides about this payment.
review.noteWithRefund: Why, and how the rest was given back (kept in the audit log)
review.notePlaceholder: For example: confirmed with the guardian by phone
review.applyIntro: Tick the dues it pays (or months ahead). The receipt is dated the day SSLCommerz took the money.
review.applyNone: This student owes nothing now and has nothing to pay ahead: record the money as refunded outside instead.
review.applyAmountHint: At most the {money} confirmed and what the ticked dues owe
review.applyRemainder: {amount} is left over: it is recorded as given back outside the app
review.refundReferenceHint: What your own records call the refund: letters, digits and - _ . /
review.refundReferenceInvalid: Use letters, digits and - _ . / only (100 at most).
review.refundTitle: Record {amount} as refunded outside the app
review.refundIntro: The whole amount was given back outside the app (SSLCommerz's merchant panel, or by hand). This cannot be undone here.
review.refunded: Recorded as refunded outside the app
review.dismissIntro: It holds no money, and SSLCommerz found no payment for it. If money arrives later it comes back here.
review.dismissRepeatIntro: The same money is recorded elsewhere (on a payment or another item), so this record can go.
review.checkedTitle: {n, plural, one {Checked, not a payment ({count})} other {Checked, not payments ({count})}}
review.checkedHint: Notifications SSLCommerz said were not this store's payments, in the last 30 days. Nothing to do.

err.ALREADY_RESOLVED: Someone has already decided about this payment.
err.DUES_CHANGED: What these dues owe changed (or their fines on the payment day differ): check the amount and confirm again.
err.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_DUE: That is more than the ticked dues owe.
err.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_MONEY: That is more than SSLCommerz confirmed.
err.REMAINDER_NEEDS_REFUND: The rest of the money must be recorded as given back.
err.NO_MONEY: No money was confirmed for this payment: dismiss it instead.
err.HAS_MONEY: This holds money: apply it or record it as refunded, never dismiss it.
err.CHECK_FIRST: Check with SSLCommerz first: dismiss needs a check in the last 15 minutes that found no payment.
err.CURRENCY_NOT_APPLICABLE: Money in another currency is refunded, never applied.
err.AMOUNT_UNKNOWN: SSLCommerz did not report a usable amount: record it as refunded.
err.TRX_ID_UNUSABLE: SSLCommerz did not report a usable transaction ID: record it as refunded.
err.TRX_ID_USED: This bank transaction is already recorded as a payment.
